description: Outreach queue — prepared drafts awaiting HUMAN execution. Nothing here is sent automatically. Each entry references a lead record (or a segment for segment-level content), the drafted message, the channel, and the review state.
rules: Every entry references marketing/leads/<org>.json or a segment id.
Drafts follow the segment's outreach_style and evidence_requirements.
Status flow: drafted → reviewed (by the human operator) → executed (by the human operator) → outcome recorded.
No bulk unsolicited messages; first contact is always individually reviewed.
